name: Monmouth County Audubon Bird Conservation Grant
summary: Small reimbursement grants for one-year habitat projects in Monmouth County, New Jersey that benefit birds, such as native plantings, nest boxes and nesting platforms, open to nonprofits and municipal environmental commissions.
reporting: Grantees complete the project and submit a final report with documentation within one year, plus at least three photos or graphics.

eligibility.rule: Be a 501(c)(3)/(c)(4) nonprofit, or a Monmouth County municipal environmental commission set up by ordinance
Locate the project within Monmouth County, New Jersey
Complete the project within one year of its start date
Have no travel or labor costs for local volunteers, officials, municipal staff, or applicant staff

documents: IRS letter of determination, if a nonprofit
Signed governing-body resolution, if a nonprofit
Signed municipal endorsement letter, if an environmental commission

deadline.text: 5 p.m. Eastern Standard Time on January 15, 2026

status.quote: All applications must be submitted by e-mail to mcasconservationgrant@yahoo.com by 5 p.m. Eastern Standard Time on January 15, 2026.

deadline.quote: All applications must be submitted by e-mail to mcasconservationgrant@yahoo.com by 5 p.m. Eastern Standard Time on January 15, 2026.

pool.quote: The Monmouth Audubon Bird Conservation Grant Program will award a maximum of $3,000 in grants for 2026.

applicant_types.quote: All nonprofit 501(c)(3) or 501(c)(4) organizations as well as any of Monmouth County's municipal environmental commissions are eligible to apply

geography.quote: Projects must be located within Monmouth County, New Jersey.

access.quote: The Monmouth County Audubon Society (MCAS) is offering small grants for a one-year project that will advance bird conservation.

window.quote: All applications must be submitted by e-mail to mcasconservationgrant@yahoo.com by 5 p.m. Eastern Standard Time on January 15, 2026.

amount.quote: The maximum request per proposal is $1,500 ($150 is the minimum).

reporting.quote: Grantees have one year to complete projects and submit final report/documentation for reimbursement. Projects running past one year without authorization from MCAS in writing are subject to forfeit their payment. Grantees are required to submit a minimum of 3 representative photos or other graphics for MCAS's use in publications and online.

effort.quote: All applications must be submitted by e-mail to mcasconservationgrant@yahoo.com by 5 p.m. Eastern Standard Time on January 15, 2026.
All proposals will be reviewed by an MCAS technical review committee.

eligibility.quote: All nonprofit 501(c)(3) or 501(c)(4) organizations as well as any of Monmouth County's municipal environmental commissions are eligible to apply and are welcome to apply for, and receive, more than one grant per cycle. Environmental commissions are only eligible if they represent a municipality within Monmouth County, NJ and have been established by ordinance.
Projects must be located within Monmouth County, New Jersey.
Projects must be completed within one year of the start date.
Ineligible expenses include travel or labor by local volunteers, officials, municipal staff, or the grant applicant's staff.

after_award.quote: Grantees have one year to complete projects and submit final report/documentation for reimbursement.

documents.quote: Budget - Itemize costs for the entire project. Be sure to specify the amount being requested. 2. Calendar - List your timeline and completion date. Projects must be completed within one year of the start date. 3. For non-profits, an IRS letter of determination stating the organization's nonprofit status (does not apply to Environmental Commissions).
For non-profits, a signed Resolution by the non-profit's governing body authorizing the organization to apply for the grant and enter a grant agreement if the application is selected.

For Environmental Commissions, a scanned, dated and signed letter from the municipal manager or administrator indicating endorsement of the application and assuring payment of any additional costs that are included in the budget.
